messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync request — Lattice + their SI want a clear SEV path that ties marketplace listing controls, an ops bridge, and an explicit handback cadence. Thinking: shared channel + pinned runbook + automation hooks.

Owen Chen: Agree. Minimal friction for oncall. We should have a /partner-incident create that spins up a channel + posts a checklist. cc @Redwood Ops Bot to show what we can automate.

Redwood Ops Bot: I can create channels and post templates. Example:
```/partner-incident create --partner=lattice --sev=P1 --include-si=true```
Will post: channel topic with runbook shortlink, current oncall, and listing-freeze flag.

Samir Rao: Let's lock down severity mapping first — partners say "sev1/sev2". Proposal: partner sev1 -> Redwood P1 (customer-down or data-loss); partner sev2 -> Redwood P2 (partial impact). SI urgent escalations where customer is affected escalate to P1 automatically.

Jill (SI Lead): From SI POV: we need write-access to upload traces and sanitized logs to the channel (service-account). Can that be scoped to a limited retention? We can't host customer logs forever.

Tessa L: We'll use a read/write partner service account with 48h artifact retention by default. Pin RBAC notes in the runbook. Also add a marketplace flag so Product pauses updates to the listing while a SEV is open.

Ben (Lattice Eng): We will staff 24/7 for true P1s but need a clean handback rule. Our ask: ops returns incident only after mitigated and a postmortem owner is assigned (target: within 4h). Need clear paging mapping to SI rotation.

Owen Chen: Draft SEV channel template (to pin): 1) Short triage summary, 2) Primary owner(s) (Redwood / Partner / SI), 3) Actions in flight, 4) Listing pause flag + who approves, 5) Rollback trigger and steps, 6) Postmortem owner + ETA. Keep it lightweight.

Maya Patel: Plan: I will create #partner-lattice-sev on Wednesday and invite Lattice SRE + their SI oncall. Let's run a dry-run on Friday 09:30 PT to exercise channel creation, /partner-incident flow, RBAC upload, and the handback.

Samir Rao: I'll make a 1-page checklist and a short Google doc (public to participants only) and drop it in the channel before the drill: https://go.redwood/s/lattice-sev-checklist (placeholder).

Jill (SI Lead): I'll confirm SI pager rotation and who can hit the listing-pause. Need that before the drill.

Tessa L: Also propose an automated tag that notifies Product and Marketplace when a partner SEV opens so they can suspend scheduled listing changes.

Ben (Lattice Eng): That helps. Also let's agree an emergency narrow-handoff: if Redwood needs to hand back to us during night hours, ensure both sides acknowledge with a clear timestamp and next check-in time.

Owen Chen: We'll add an acknowledgment flow: when a handback is posted the recipient must react :white_check_mark: and set a follow-up ETA. If no ack in 30m escalate to oncall lead.

Maya Patel: Action items: Maya create channel + invite (today), Samir checklist (EOD), Owen wire bot commands and ack/escalation (tomorrow), Tessa set RBAC/retention policy docs, Jill confirm SI rotation, Ben confirm handback SLA. Dry-run Friday 09:30 PT.

Redwood Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled -> dry-run Friday 09:00 PT. I will post the agenda and automation runbook in the channel at 09:10 PT. :robot_face:
